description: This file declares the NtlmClient class which implements an NTLMv1/NTLMv2 client supporting features like MIC and EPA, including methods for generating NTLM authentication messages and negotiate messages.

classes.name: NtlmClient
classes.description: Implements NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 client functionality with support for MIC and EPA, providing methods to generate NTLM messages.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessage
methods.description: Generates an NTLM authenticate message with detailed parameters including domain, username, password, hostname, channel bindings, SPN, client time, and challenge messages.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessageV1
methods.description: Simplified NTLMv1 authenticate message generator without channel bindings, SPN, or client time.
